2) **What is your order ID** (it looks like `#W0000000`)?
3) For “return everything except the tablet”: can you tell me **the item name of the tablet** (or the exact item(s) to keep), and confirm the **E-Reader** is the only other item you want to return?
4) Which payment method should the refund go to (e.g., **gift card**, **PayPal**, or **credit card**)?

Once I have the order ID, I can pull the order details and tell you **the exact refund amount** based on the return of the E-Reader only.

I actually don’t remember my email address, but my name is Yusuf Gonzalez and my zip code is 91455. I don’t have the order ID handy right now—can you look it up with my name and zip code?

As for the items, I want to keep just the tablet and return everything else, including the E-Reader. I’d like the refund to go back to my credit card. Can you let me know how much I’ll get back?
